xiuos._comment_program_timeout: wedge-detection budget (Poll frees slot + reboots if no RESULT). Sweep 2026-05-29: 15000ms→27 completion/82 PC; 3000ms→134/171; 1000ms→273/176. Coverage saturates ≤3000ms; below that = more execs, flat coverage + reboot churn. 1500ms = throughput/churn balance. Root fix = worker bounded-blocking (eliminate wedges).

fuzzer._comment_capacity: MUST exceed the loaded seed count (persistence.corpus.dir ~35961 wire seeds) + growth headroom. capacity<loaded made SizeBudgetFilter (Size()<capacity) reject EVERY admit → corpus frozen → no exploration-frontier growth in any run incl. the 9h (corpus_growth=0). See docs/plans/xiuos-state-coverage-exploration.md §8.2.
